peopleAlsoAsk.snippet:
"The ABC's of CBT”

A stands for "activating event." The actual event and one's immediate interpretations of the event. B stands for "beliefs about the event." This evaluation can be rational or irrational. C stands for "consequences." How you feel and what you do or other thoughts.Jun 18, 2024
